{{Top|leg}}
The '''Adarlonians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. [[Drun Cairnwick/Legends|Drun Cairnwick]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] initiate who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and escaped the fall of the Order during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was from Adarlon.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
